content:
Want to discover new iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has plenty of ad-free, in-app purchase-free games to choose from.

Apple Arcade is a family-friendly subscription option, but it's not the only one. If you're already subscribed to Netflix, you've actually already paid to play a host of excellent iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a massive library of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription now includes a huge library of mobile and TV games.

This includes the most affordable 'Standard with ads' plan, which costs just $8.99 USD per month.

Regardless of which Netflix plan you've chosen, access to mobile and TV games is already included, with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

As for TV games, Netflix offers a dedicated iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into a game controller to use with supported Netflix smart TV apps. If you want to further enhance your mobile gaming experience, a dedicated iPhone game controller would be a great choice.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, featuring mini-games designed for kids. Additionally, there's Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond the above titles, Netflix supports over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store, then log in with your Netflix email and password to start playing.
